theorem_formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingSourceSelect.program_meets_fits {lim : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Limits} {μ : ℕ→ℤ} {d pair bank cover srcB srcC i j code J dst : ℕ}
    (X : _root_.ThreeSum.ReportingHostSourceSelection.Pointers) (H : _root_.ThreeSum.ReportingHostSourceSelection.HeaderReads μ X pair bank cover i j code)
    (hw : (lim.space : ℤ)≤lim.word)
    (hs : _root_.ThreeSum.ReportingHostSourceSelection.Fits X pair bank cover srcB srcC i j code J dst lim.space) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.Meets lim _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.LightReportingSourceSelect.program 0 d [pair,bank,cover,srcB,srcC,i,j,code,J,dst] μ 6000
      (fun result ν => result=(dst : ℤ) ∧ _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.SegN ν dst (_root_.ThreeSum.ReportingHostSourceSelection.values X srcB srcC code J) ∧
        _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.Light.SameOutside μ ν dst 15) := by sorry
theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let $\lambda$ be run limits, $\mu$ an integer memory, and $d$ a call depth. Fix source-pair, bank, cover and original B/C addresses, band indices $i,j$, an occurrence code, block count $J$, and destination $a$. Let $X$ be the pointer record whose required header reads hold in $\mu$. Assume the address space fits the word bound and the selection-fit predicate places every required read, scalar and fifteen-cell output within the limits. Then procedure zero of the fixed source-selector program satisfies

$$\operatorname{steps}\le6000,\qquad r=a,$$

and writes the fifteen natural-valued source-selection fields determined by $X$, the B/C bases, the code and $J$ at $a$. Every cell outside those fifteen is unchanged.

This replaces abstract source selection by a bounded actual execution before the original-value reporter.
